name: blueprint/geo-context
description: Turn a place query into agent context: geocode with rh_places_geocode, then elevation + weather + nearby at those coordinates, cached in rh_store with a TTL so repeated questions stay free.
use_cases: what is the weather where X is
is X above the snow line
ingredients: rh_places_geocode / rh_places_address / rh_places_elevation / rh_places_nearby (Nominatim + Open-Meteo, keyless)
rh_store TTL cache keyed by place
recipe: query -> rh_places_geocode (first hit wins) -> parallel rh_places_elevation + rh_weather_forecast + rh_weather_air at the hit coordinates -> rh_places_nearby for the around-me question -> rh_store_put { ...context, fetchedAt } -> subsequent asks hit the cache while fresh
result_kind: one store record per place: { place, elevation, weather, air, nearby, fetchedAt }

invoke_contract.output: geo-context record (place + elevation + weather + air + nearby)

cost_hint: free (both providers keyless; the cache keeps repeat calls near zero)
pitfalls: Nominatim usage policy: identify yourself with a User-Agent and keep to agent-paced 1 req/s
reverse-geocode misses answer HTTP 200 with { error } - surface it, do not fabricate a place
nearby = bounded search: viewbox of left,top,right,bottom + bounded=1; distanceKm is computed client-side (haversine), Nominatim returns none
geocode result order is importance-ranked, not exact-match - confirm the first hit is the intended place before the weather calls
weather/air output schemas reject null - absent pollutants are omitted, not null
local_limits: Nominatim public instance is rate-limited; cache before you retry anything
cloud_limits: same keyless endpoints reachable from a Worker; egress mostly free
